source_unknown_policy: Unknown is a legitimate source value. Completion may use named authored bridge cards but must retain the unknown and task-choice provenance. Never award source-complete reproduction for those bridged details.

completion_labels.design_complete: All declared paper branches have initial states, goals, object actions, output bindings, evaluator conditions and gap labels in this design
completion_labels.task_episode_complete: Requires future trusted runtime event history satisfying all hard gates; not established by this delivery

reused specimen ID with renamed carrier

source_reported_steps_convention: Methods numbers labeled number_of_steps_source_literal retain the source wording. Do not assume whether a controller counts planes or intervals; a named task-controller adapter may choose a frame convention, recorded as authored rather than paper fact.

preparation_material_transfer_requiremen.seed: Stock specimen ancestry moves to the chosen carrier in the work vessel; stock vial and derived specimen are separate objects
preparation_material_transfer_requiremen.section: Block remains at sectioning station; new section gets a child identity and its own support slide
preparation_material_transfer_requiremen.wash: Material buffer ancestry updates but specimen and carrier remain unchanged
preparation_material_transfer_requiremen.mount: Same prepared specimen-bearing carrier becomes supported by holder; do not spawn a duplicate final sample
preparation_material_transfer_requiremen.repeat_or_restart: Fresh replacement starts a new child specimen ID; its failed sibling remains in quarantine
